label: Possibly, contingent reality began a finite time ago (BEGINS_2)
paraphrase: OPEN analyst premise B1 in sense BEGINS_2, attribution deferred: some history accessible from the selected world has a moment at which a contingent concrete individual is present, and in that history every moment at which a contingent concrete individual is present has a past of finite duration on the supplied clock (readings at or before it bounded below). It does NOT say there is a first moment: a populated history whose time is open below and of finite duration, as in standard FLRW cosmology, satisfies it. It says nothing about an empty moment or a cause. Duration is read on the supplied clock: the Lean type allows any order-preserving real coordinate (CLOCK_2); the intended reading is the physically privileged duration (CLOCK_1). 'Concrete' is the supplied Concrete parameter.
